description: Check an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 or Swagger 2.0 document (JSON or YAML) for the mistakes that break tools: missing required fields, undeclared path parameters, invalid status codes, duplicate operationIds, broken $refs, undefined security schemes and examples that don't match their schema. Returns each problem with a JSON pointer and, for JSON, a line number.

spec.description: The whole OpenAPI or Swagger document, as JSON or YAML text.

name: validate_openapi
title: Validate an OpenAPI spec
